meta.title: Shopping list
meta.description: View and manage the items on a shopping list.

access.view: You can only view this list.
access.shop: You can check off what you've bought and choose a store, but you can't change the list.
access.edit: You can change quantities and delete products, but you can't add new ones.

unavailable.deadLinkDescription: The owner has stopped sharing this list, or the link is wrong.
